list.name: Name
list.orphansHelp: No one in the owner department can manage permissions for these diagrams. Recovering gives you edit permission so you can set permissions again.

view.deleteConfirm: Delete this diagram? An administrator can restore it.
view.lockedBy: {name} is editing (since {time}). You can only view.
view.editingElsewhere: You are editing in another window. This window is view-only.

edit.discardConfirm: Discard unsaved changes and finish editing?
edit.editing: Editing. Editing ends in {minutes} min without changes. Draft is saved every minute.
edit.warn: Editing ends in {minutes} min. Change the drawing or save to continue.
edit.revertConfirm: Unsaved changes will be lost. Revert to this version?
edit.attachableHelp: Attach to and move with another shape

picker.title: Place equipment
picker.search: Find by name or serial number

settings.title: Equipment display settings
settings.shareHelp: Equipment fields shown to users with view permission (info display, tooltip, PNG). Users with edit permission see all fields. A placed box shows the equipment name.
settings.nameFixed: The equipment name is always shared because it is the box text.
settings.shareAttributesHelp: Set per department attribute. Nothing is shared at first, including same-name attributes created later. File attributes show file names only.
settings.shareShapeInfoHelp: Also shows the shape info written on shapes and lines that are not equipment to view-only users (info display, PNG, print). Only the equipment fields turned on above are shown. Not shared at first.
settings.sharePhotoHelp: Also shows the photo registered in equipment details to view-only users (inside boxes, tooltip, PNG, print). Shared at first.

shapeInfo.title: Shape info
shapeInfo.help: Write information on a shape that is not registered equipment, like equipment. All fields are optional; turn on the same item in Info display to show it below the shape.
shapeInfo.lineHelp: For a line, write the network list, network type and memo. All fields are optional; turn on the same item in Info display to show it next to the middle of the line.

errors.network: Enter an IP address or a MAC address on each network row.
errors.mac: Enter the MAC address as 12 hexadecimal digits (e.g. 02-00-00-00-00-01).
errors.macDuplicate: The same MAC address cannot be entered twice for one shape.

grants.title: Permissions
grants.help: Pick people or departments and give view or edit permission. A department grant covers its members only (not sub-departments).
grants.readOnly: Editors in the owner department manage permissions.

errors.linkFixed: Only internal links (starting with /, up to 500 characters) are allowed, so the link was removed.
